messages:
maria: Heads up — we've got a customer report that SDK sees 503 during failover but console shows 'quota' badge. Confusing.
raj: saw same in telemetry. Route_reason tag shows 'fallback_pool_full' but client gets 503.
sam: short answer: it's messy. legacy router emits 503 for any non-success, then SDK maps 429 if subcode contains 'QUOTA'. Not consistent.
oliver: that's the problem. Customers can't programmatically distinguish quota vs capacity throttles.
maria: proposal: surface a lightweight client_error field with values: quota_exceeded, rate_limited, capacity_constrained, model_unavailable; keep HTTP codes as current but add 'x-rw-reason' header. Thoughts?
raj: +1 for enumerated reason. But we can't add new headers to 3rd party enterprise proxies. Maybe add in response body 'client_reason' for JSON responses.
sam: for streaming/binary responses body addition tricky. Header fallback would be nicer. Also need to think SDKs older than v1.2.
maria: SDKs can parse both header and body. plan: add header x-rwinference-reason; body 'rwinference.reason' when header absent. We'll ship feature flag.
oliver: console UX: we need badge mapping to these enum values. e.g., quota_exceeded -> 'Quota', capacity_constrained -> 'Degraded routing'. Telemetry tag: route_reason -> the internal code, client_reason -> enum.
raj: plus we should reserve a 'fallback' boolean when client actually received substitute model. helps explain quality drops.
sam: sample response:
```json
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-rwinference-reason: capacity_constrained
{
  "error": "Service temporarily degraded",
  "rwinference": {"reason":"capacity_constrained","fallback":true}
}
```
maria: rollout plan: feature-flag on canary, SDK bump to read header+body, console wires up badges, docs + migration guide. Target next week's deploy window.
oliver: open Q: mapping to HTTP codes — do we want 429 for quota_exceeded even when logic path is a failover (we currently 503)? I vote yes: quota -> 429, capacity -> 503.
raj: agree. We'll need backward-compatibility: old clients may misinterpret; in rollout we keep existing codes but add header; after 4 weeks flip to canonical codes.
maria: I'll draft RFC and console changes. tagging: @devex for SDK packaging, @monitoring for telemetry schema change. :thumbsup: 
console-bot: created RFC tracker: rfc/2026-client-reasons-in-error-contract — link: https://go/infra/rfc/2026
oliver: thanks. I'll add the dashboard ticket for badge remapping.
